title: cynoglossum hispidum
intro: Cynoglossum hispidum, commonly known as Rough Comfrey or Hispid Hound's-tongue, is a flowering plant species in the borage family (Boraginaceae). This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include wound healing, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Cynoglossum hispidum are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which have been shown to exhibit antioxidant and anti-inflammatory activities. Additionally, its leaves and roots are used in traditional medicine for their reported ability to promote tissue repair and reduce inflammation.
